scope: Local pilot proposal; does not establish agreement by other experiment participants

environment.coordinates: x east, y north; array row increases with y

sensor.sampling: grid centers and people at t=0 and each decision endpoint; no path sensing

service.priority: existing owner, then distance, then UAV id; target id for overlapping new services
service.short_step: first intersection with discovered unrescued service disk; an already-inside UAV may depart

water.interpolation: piecewise linear; endpoint checks bound depth and velocity norm for a hovering target over the complete service interval

collision.test: exact piecewise straight synchronous trajectories including short-step stops
collision.response: stop conflicting UAVs, recursively recheck resulting paths
collision.ACC: original intention unordered pairs per joint step; no divide by fleet size

environment.communication: ideal complete sharing of actually observed data and public UAV state
environment.training_information: same observed histories as execution; no hidden terrain, hidden people or future water
environment.termination: all 20 served AND all cells observed, otherwise 300-step finite horizon
environment.flight_scope: synthetic planar kinematics; no battery, buildings, weather or physical hoist model

representation.extra: public UAV positions/headings/last actions, own id and remaining time; unknown fields have a separate mask
representation.temporal_memory: explicit observed map and timestamps; no recurrent network in first pilot

pilot.formal_budget: decide from measured pilot cost and validation curves; not approved as an automatic long run

hasac.discrete_actor_expectation: exact nine-action enumeration; adaptation from sampled official discrete update

maac.critic: other-agent multihead attention, own-action-excluded Q vector

mat.joint_execution: all computed actions execute together; no mid-step measurement

coma.critic: Q_i for all own actions conditioned on allowed joint history and other actions

learning.implementation_status: new compact adaptations; no claim of exact official-code or benchmark reproduction; runtime and numerical tests not executed
